meta.description: The curated Polymarket events shown on economic-dashboard.html and fetched by .github/workflows/fetch-polymarket-data.yml. This file is the single list of markets; neither the page nor the workflow names a market itself.
meta.how_to_add: Add one entry. `slug` is the Polymarket event slug. `section` is one of the dashboard sections below. `role` picks how the event is rendered (see ROLES in economic-dashboard.html). `key` names the element ids (pm-<key>, pm-<key>-detail, ...) and must be unique. `kpi` is optional and adds a headline tile.
meta.settled_markets: A market that settles is dropped from data/polymarket-data.json by the fetcher and listed in dropped_settled; the page then stops rendering its card. Removing the entry from this file afterwards is housekeeping, not a fix.

events.label: Fed Decision — October 2026
events.description: FOMC meeting October 27-28. Directly sets short-term rate environment for construction loans and variable-rate debt.

events.label: Rate Cuts in 2026
events.description: Number of 25bp cuts expected this year. Fewer cuts = higher mortgage rates = tighter affordability for Colorado buyers.

events.label: Fed Decision — January 2027
events.description: Next major decision point. Rate trajectory affects permanent debt terms and LIHTC equity pricing.

events.label: 30-Year Mortgage Rate in 2026
events.description: Sets the debt constant on every ownership pro forma and the affordability ceiling for first-time buyers.

events.label: US Recession by End of 2026?
events.description: Two consecutive negative GDP quarters or NBER announcement. A recession would sharply curtail new CO construction starts and LIHTC deal flow.

events.label: GDP Growth in 2026
events.description: Full-year real GDP growth. Stronger growth supports CO job market, in-migration, and housing demand along the Front Range.

events.label: Inflation Peak in 2026
events.description: CPI thresholds during any month. Higher inflation = rising construction material costs, eroding LIHTC rent affordability margins.

events.label: Tech Layoffs Up or Down in 2026?
events.description: Front Range tech employment is a key demand driver for Denver/Boulder housing. Rising layoffs weaken high-end rental absorption.
